correctness.rationale: Integral surgery on the two-component link with coefficients 2m+15 and 0 and linking number m+2 presents first homology by L_m=((2m+15,m+2),(m+2,0)). Its determinant is -(m+2)^2 and its entry gcd is gcd(m+2,11); the full-rank two-by-two Smith theorem gives the two invariant factors. The source determinant verifies the group order for all m>=1.

value.rationale: First integral homology of the double branched cover is a natural invariant strictly finer than determinant. The all-parameter mod-11 split gives infinitely many quasi-alternating branch links whose covers are not lens spaces and hence whose links are not two-bridge; no converse is asserted. The group computation is short and standard, so importance is confined to this natural family-specific obstruction.
